images.alt: Overlapping image views connect to a shared 3D scene. Original conceptual illustration, not a reconstruction result.
RGB observations enter learned geometry prediction. Depending on the method, outputs include pointmaps, depth and cameras; post-processing varies.
Static reconstruction maps overlapping RGB views to a shared 3D scene. Dynamic reconstruction additionally represents changing geometry and motion across frames.

Three different targets: Gaussian scene representations rendered from a new camera, semantic labels attached to observed geometry, and inferred structure behind an occluder. Hidden geometry is drawn dashed to mark inference.

Pose estimation recovers camera position and orientation in a reference frame. A robot application combines geometry with a persistent map and goals to select actions; a map alone is not a navigation policy.
